# Correct X4 Pro reader panels

This release implements the X4 Pro reader chrome as a fixed two-panel layout matching the intended design.

## Fixed

- The top and bottom reader panels are now solid black with white content in both normal and night modes.
- The clock is always shown at the upper left when the X4 Pro RTC is available.
- The battery percentage is always shown in a compact white battery at the upper right.
- Book progress is always shown at the lower left.
- The current chapter is always centered in the lower panel.
- The current and total chapter pages are always shown at the lower right.

## Notes

- Book typography, line breaking, justification, hyphenation, and page content rendering are unchanged.
- This is an X4 Pro-only firmware release containing only `firmware-x4pro.bin`.
- Includes the calendar-based reading statistics introduced in 1.5.0-16.
